first_stage_cp23_became_cp2.detail: Configio High for octal 2705: Desc=CP23 Bank=58 In_Out=0000000011111111 (OUTPUT). EIP CP23 OA4 slot12 out_bank=58. Numerically identical CP2 IA4 slot17 in_bank=58. Pre-fix: High searched with word_dir=I across ALL adapters -> matched CP2 IA4 Data[17]. That was the first stage CP23 ownership became CP2.

root_cause: Cross-panel bank-number collision + word-level direction forced onto High half. Bank namespaces are per adapter/panel; High half of 2705 is OUTPUT (OA4) while Low is INPUT (IA4).
fix: 1) Panel-scope bank joins via _panel_token. 2) Per-half direction from In_Out mask; search opposite direction in-scope for split words. 3) Foreign-panel hits return cross_panel_bank_join_blocked.
